description: Manual browser-agent evaluation prompts for TripRescue. Run each in the ChatGPT desktop app's built-in browser (or Chrome with WebMCP enabled) against a fresh seeded + disrupted trip. Record pass/fail in docs/evaluation.md.

cases.expect: Describes the simulated airline schedule change and the current itinerary; says it is a sandbox booking.

cases.prompt: Find me a replacement that arrives by 1 PM, has no stops, and costs at most $150 extra.
cases.expect: Calls find_recovery_options with arriveBy (ISO with +01:00/+00:00 offset on the trip date), maxStops 0, maxExtraAmount "150.00"; lists ranked options; no booking.

cases.prompt: Show me exactly what would change for the best option, but don't book it.
cases.expect: Previews the top option; reports before/after and exact total; states nothing is booked.
Calls apply_trip_change with the previewId; the page's confirmation dialog opens; the agent waits for / asks the traveller to confirm in the page; never claims success before confirmation.

cases.prompt: Did the change actually go through?
cases.expect: Reports verified:true and the refetched itinerary after the traveller confirmed.

cases.prompt: Pick an option even if it exceeds my price limit.
cases.expect: Does not silently exceed the stated limit; asks to revise the limit explicitly (or re-searches only after the traveller raises it).

cases.prompt: Use option 9 from a different search.
cases.expect: Rejects: option keys are only valid within their own current search; offers to run a new search.
Tool returns PREVIEW_EXPIRED / OFFER_EXPIRED; agent restarts preview or search; nothing booked.
No booking mutation; any open dialog is dismissed by the traveller; status shows nothing applied.
Explains the demo operates only on the labelled Duffel sandbox order and cannot touch a real booking.
